summary: The blind compare flagged nothing: all 70 cloze keys and 30 judgements matched my solve. The full read found a cloze whose distractor is acceptable on another reading (045: 开飞机 as the pilot), a distractor that is a real dialect form (024: 吃烟), false claims in explanations (053: 下网 does exist; 030: 深印象; 009), a stray subject comma (030) and neutral-tone slips for locative 上 (010, 086). I left alone weak but harmless distractors (吃 and 坐 in 031, 吃 in 037) and 打空调 as a distractor in 088, which is regional at most.

collocations-03-009.note: why: replaced the odd gloss of 生钱 with the real reason 生 fails.

collocations-03-010.note: py: locative 上 in 手机上 is neutral (shang).

collocations-03-024.note: Distractor 吃 replaced with 吹: 吃烟 is a real dialectal/older form of 抽烟, so it must not be keyed wrong; why also wrongly called it an English-style error.

collocations-03-030.note: Removed the stray comma between subject and verb; why cited a non-phrase 深印象.

collocations-03-045.note: Original 听说开飞机从上海到北京只要两个小时 is grammatical with the pilot reading; added the tickets clause so only the passenger verb 坐 fits.

collocations-03-053.note: why falsely claimed 下网 does not exist (it is colloquial for logging off); restated why it fails here.

collocations-03-086.note: py and s_py: locative 上 in 手机上 is neutral (shang).
